propositions: Container tickets with children have empty file_impact and fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation on any unrelated commit, causing excessive re-review friction in parallel epic workflows.

The scope a container plan reviews should be the union of its own file_impact, review citations, and direct children's declared file_impact, with a poison rule: if any non-closed child has empty file_impact, inheritance is disabled and whole-HEAD fallback is preserved.
A child editing its file_impact after container review must invalidate the container's attestation via pin/material drift, triggering re-review that recomputes the inherited union.

When inheritance is effective (all non-closed direct children declare non-empty file_impact), unrelated commits must not invalidate the container attestation, but commits to child-declared files must block the claim and name the drift.
Closed children must neither contribute file paths to the union nor poison the inheritance rule, since their work is delivered and belongs to other tickets by ADR 0024.

P9 plan-review floor check must surface an advisory (never blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming the children with empty file_impact, so authors see why the epic stays on whole-HEAD invalidation.
